visual.general_description: Six round endoscopic-style color views (a-f) of pink-red tissue with dark central openings, ridged folds and a pale grey-white mass in the last view.
visual.detailed_description: Panel a: Circular field with a black surround. Pink to red surface with scattered small bright round dots in yellow, pink and white, and reddish patches at the lower right. A thin pale vertical strand hangs from the top edge near the centre, and a raised fold runs down the right edge. The printed letter "a" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel b: Circular field with a black surround. A thick rounded pink ridge with a pale glistening patch on top curves across the lower centre, with a dark irregular opening beneath it at the lower centre. Pink folded tissue fills the upper right and small bright dots lie at the left. The printed letter "b" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel c: Circular field with a black surround. A dark, roughly triangular opening with greyish interior sits at the centre-right, surrounded by dull pink-brown tissue with concentric folds and a few reddish areas. One small bright dot is at the upper right of the opening. The printed letter "c" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel d: Circular field with a black surround. A central dark opening crossed by several horizontal dark and grey ridges, surrounded by pink-red tissue with small reddish spots and a few bright dots at the upper right. The printed letter "d" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel e: Circular field with a black surround. A dark irregular opening at the centre contains grey-brown ridged tissue, with a pale whitish flap along its upper right edge. Surrounding tissue is pink-red with small dark red spots, and a bright bubble-like dot lies at the upper left. The printed letter "e" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel f: Circular field with a black surround. A pale grey-white, smooth to mottled mass fills the centre, with a dark red-brown recess along its upper right side and pink smooth tissue forming the left and right margins. The printed letter "f" is at the lower right of the black surround.

visual.general_description: Six round endoscopic-style color views (a-f) of pink to orange tissue with dark central openings of varying size and a pale rounded structure.
visual.detailed_description: Panel a: Circular field with a black surround. Smooth pink tissue with a small round dark opening at the lower left of centre and a pale rounded, tongue-like structure curving above and to its right. A patch of small whitish granular dots lies at the upper left edge. The printed letter "a" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel b: Circular field with a black surround. A pale pink-white fold narrows from the top towards the bottom centre, where a large black round opening sits at the lower centre. Pink tissue with a white glare line lies at the upper left. The printed letter "b" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel c: Circular field with a black surround. A broad pale pink-white band crosses the upper part of the field and a large black oval opening fills the lower centre. Darker pink tissue lies at the upper right and a few small bright dots are near the centre. The printed letter "c" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel d: Circular field with a black surround. Orange-pink tissue forms concentric rounded folds around a small dark horizontal slit at the centre-lower part, with scattered tiny bright dots. The printed letter "d" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel e: Circular field with a black surround. Red-pink tissue surrounds a pale oval structure at the centre-left that contains a small black round opening at its lower end. Tiny green and white specks lie on and around the structure, and a diagonal darker fold runs across the lower right. The printed letter "e" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel f: Circular field with a black surround. A pale rounded structure occupies the centre and upper part, with a thin dark curved slit along its lower edge fringed with green and magenta color. Pink tissue lies around it and a pale pink band crosses the bottom. The printed letter "f" is at the lower right of the black surround.

panels.general_description: Round endoscopic-style color view of pink tissue with a small dark opening and a pale rounded structure above it.

visual.general_description: Nine round endoscopic-style color views (a-i) of pink tissue, some with a dark cleft, bubbles, bright reflections or whitish streaks.
visual.detailed_description: Panel a: Circular field with a black surround. A dark vertical cleft runs from the upper centre down to the lower centre between pink tissue at the left and a bright whitish-pink rounded surface at the right. A few thin lines and a small bright reflection lie at the upper left of the cleft. The printed letter "a" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel b: Circular field with a black surround. The whole field is a grey-pink wet-looking surface covered with many small round bubbles and several bright white irregular reflective patches in the centre and right. The printed letter "b" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel c: Circular field with a black surround. A smooth pale pink surface fills the right and upper areas, bounded by a curved diagonal edge running from upper left to lower right, with a darker pink-brown area at the lower left. No other markings are visible. The printed letter "c" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel d: Circular field with a black surround. A pale pink-white rounded surface lies at the left and smooth pink tissue at the right, separated by a dark narrow cleft that widens toward the lower left. The printed letter "d" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel e: Circular field with a black surround. Pink-white tissue shows horizontal reddish patches across the middle and upper area and whitish fibrous-looking streaks in the lower area, with a small white fleck at the right edge. The printed letter "e" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel f: Circular field with a black surround. A reddish horizontal band crosses the upper centre, and whitish streaks fan out toward the lower left. A grey-blue patch lies at the right edge and a few small white dots are at the lower right. The printed letter "f" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel g: Circular field with a black surround. A narrow dark vertical cleft runs from the top to the lower centre between a pale pink-white rounded surface at the left and pink tissue at the right. Two tiny bright dots lie on the cleft. The printed letter "g" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel h: Circular field with a black surround. Pink tissue fills the field with clusters of round bubbles of varied sizes along the left and lower left, and bright white curved reflective streaks in the upper centre. Pale folded tissue is at the top left. The printed letter "h" is at the lower right of the black surround. Panel i: Circular field with a black surround. Pink tissue fills the field, with a cluster of round bubbles at the lower centre and curved pale membrane-like edges forming a rounded outline at the top. Small bright reflections lie among the bubbles. The printed letter "i" is at the lower right of the black surround.
